proposals.before: An imperial grace edict raised him to first-class baron.
proposals.after: An imperial grace edict raised him to first-class count.
proposals.reason: Chinese 一等伯 is a first-class count (伯), not a baron.

proposals.before: By grace edict he was advanced to first-class baron.
proposals.after: By grace edict he was advanced to first-class count.
proposals.reason: Chinese 一等伯 is a first-class count (伯), not a baron.

proposals.before: In Kangxi 18 (1679) Wu Shifan attacked Wuzhou and Chengye defeated him.
proposals.after: In Kangxi 18 (1679) Wu Shicong attacked Wuzhou and Chengye defeated him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 吳世琮 is Wu Shicong; Wu Shifan (吳世璠) is a different person introduced later.

proposals.before: Shifan abandoned camp and fled by night; Chengye captured Xunzhou.
proposals.after: Shicong abandoned camp and fled by night; Chengye captured Xunzhou.
proposals.reason: Refers to 世琮 (Wu Shicong), not 世璠 (Wu Shifan).

proposals.before: Shifan posted a hundred thousand men at key passes in Guizhou and Guangxi while he personally besieged Nanning.
proposals.after: Shicong posted a hundred thousand men at key passes in Guizhou and Guangxi while he personally besieged Nanning.
proposals.reason: Refers to 世琮 (Wu Shicong), not 世璠.

proposals.before: Chengye marched to relieve Nanning, coordinated a pincer with the garrison, and on West Mountain at Xincun killed more than six thousand. Shifan was badly wounded and fled; the siege was raised.
proposals.after: Chengye marched to relieve Nanning, coordinated a pincer with the garrison, and on West Mountain at Xincun killed more than six thousand. Shicong was badly wounded and fled; the siege was raised.
proposals.reason: Refers to 世琮 (Wu Shicong), not 世璠.

decisions.reason: s0005 reads 恩詔進一等伯; 伯 is the count rank (cf. s0004 三等伯爵 already rendered as countship). Baron would be 男; the proposed 'first-class count' corrects the mistranslation.
s0005 has 一等伯, not 一等男. Adjacent s0004 already treats 伯爵 as a countship; advancing that title to 'first-class count' matches the Chinese, while 'baron' does not.
s0136 names the attacker 吳世琮. That is Wu Shicong; Wu Shifan is 吳世璠, a different person. Replacing Shifan with Shicong restores the correct identity.
s0137 continues with 世琮棄營宵遁 after s0136's 吳世琮; the short form still refers to Wu Shicong, not 世璠 (Wu Shifan). 'Shicong' is the correct English short name.
s0138 again subjects the clause to 世琮, the same Wu Shicong of s0136–s0137. Rendering him as Shifan conflates him with 吳世璠; 'Shicong' is accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 世琮以十萬人分屯貴州、廣西諸要隘

decisions.reason: s0139 has 世琮負重傷敗走, still Wu Shicong from the preceding sentences. Changing Shifan to Shicong corrects the misidentification without altering the rest of the sentence.
